message: We all have that one friend who panics at the first sign of trouble, right? 😊 Sometimes it’s good to be a bit of a planner, and having a solid emergency kit can really help ease those worries. The Red Cross offers a great resource to help us gather essential supplies that can make a difference when unexpected situations arise. Taking a little time to prepare can be a calming act in itself, and it might just give that friend a bit of relief too! What’s your favorite tip for staying ready and calm in the face of uncertainty?
